dialogues.speaker: A voice
dialogues.en: "Excuse me......"
dialogues.text: "Excuse me......"

dialogues.jp: どこかから、もやではない声が聞こえる。
dialogues.en: I could hear a voice.
dialogues.text: I could hear a voice.

dialogues.jp:
おっとりとした……遠慮がちな……でも、はっ
きりとした声。
dialogues.en: The voice sounded mellow...... and shy...... but clear.
dialogues.text: The voice sounded mellow...... and shy...... but clear.

dialogues.jp: それきり、聞こえなくなってしまう。
dialogues.en: Then it stopped.
dialogues.text: Then it stopped.

dialogues.jp: 気のせいだったのだろうか？
dialogues.en: Was I imagining it?
dialogues.text: Was I imagining it?

dialogues.jp: それとも、夢の始まりだろうか？
dialogues.en: Or is this the beginning of a dream?
dialogues.text: Or is this the beginning of a dream?

dialogues.speaker: A voice
dialogues.en: "Excuse me......"
dialogues.text: "Excuse me......"

dialogues.jp:
再び、さっきの声が聞こえる……今度は、もっ
とはっきりと。
dialogues.en: I could hear the voice again...... it was clearer this time.
dialogues.text: I could hear the voice again...... it was clearer this time.

dialogues.jp: なんだか、どこかで聞いた声がする。
dialogues.en: It sounded familiar.
dialogues.text: It sounded familiar.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「あの……朝倉くん」
dialogues.en: "Excuse me...... Asakura-kun."
dialogues.text: "Excuse me...... Asakura-kun."

dialogues.jp: これは……萌先輩？
dialogues.en: Is it...... Moe-sempai?
dialogues.text: Is it...... Moe-sempai?

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉くん、あの……起きてください」
dialogues.en: "Asakura-kun, um...... please wake up."
dialogues.text: "Asakura-kun, um...... please wake up."

dialogues.jp: なんで、萌先輩が俺を起こしてるんだ？
dialogues.en: Why's Moe-sempai waking me up?
dialogues.text: Why's Moe-sempai waking me up?

dialogues.jp: いつもなら、音夢が起こしに来てるはずだが……。
dialogues.en: It's usually Nemu who comes to wake me up......
dialogues.text: It's usually Nemu who comes to wake me up......

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「もう、お昼休みですよ」
dialogues.en: "It's lunch break already."
dialogues.text: "It's lunch break already."

dialogues.jp:
昼……休み？　確か今は…少なくともちょっと
前までは、１時限目の授業だったはずだが……。
dialogues.en:
Lunch......break? I thought...... it was in the middle of
the first class......
dialogues.text:
Lunch......break? I thought...... it was in the middle of
the first class......

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「早く起きないと、時間がなくなってしまいま
　す」
dialogues.en: "You'll run out of time."
dialogues.text: "You'll run out of time."

dialogues.jp: ゆらゆらと、身体をゆすられる。
dialogues.en: She shook me.
dialogues.text: She shook me.

dialogues.jp:
なんだか、ゆりかごに揺られているみたいで……
気持ちいい。
dialogues.en: It feels like I'm in a cradle...... It feels good.
dialogues.text: It feels like I'm in a cradle...... It feels good.

dialogues.jp: 開こうとした｛まぶた／瞼｝に、鍵がかかる。
dialogues.en: My eyes didn't open.
dialogues.text: My eyes didn't open.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「困りました……」
揺れが収まる。
dialogues.en: The shaking had stopped.
dialogues.text: The shaking had stopped.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「あの……起きてください」
dialogues.en: "Excuse me...... please wake up."
dialogues.text: "Excuse me...... please wake up."

dialogues.jp: ｛りん／凛｝とした声が、聞こえてくる。
dialogues.en: She sounded a little stronger this time.
dialogues.text: She sounded a little stronger this time.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「起きてくださらないと……叩きますよ」
dialogues.en: "If you don't wake up...... I'll smack you."
dialogues.text: "If you don't wake up...... I'll smack you."

dialogues.jp: ――叩く？
dialogues.en: ...Slap me?
dialogues.text: ...Slap me?

dialogues.jp: 萌先輩らしからぬ言葉に、少しだけ意識が動く。
dialogues.en: I almost woke up from her unusual words.
dialogues.text: I almost woke up from her unusual words.

dialogues.jp:
いや、萌先輩に限って、そんなことはありえな
い。
dialogues.en: Moe-sempai would never do such a thing.
dialogues.text: Moe-sempai would never do such a thing.

dialogues.jp: 俺は、生物共通の欲望に――ひざまずいた。
dialogues.en: I fell back to sleep---.
dialogues.text: I fell back to sleep---.

dialogues.jp: ――ガツンっ！！！！
dialogues.en: ---Smack!!!!
dialogues.text: ---Smack!!!!

dialogues.jp:
後頭部に、凄まじい衝撃を食らい、声にならな
い｛うめ／呻｝きが漏れる。
dialogues.en: I groaned feeling the pain on the back of my head.
dialogues.text: I groaned feeling the pain on the back of my head.

dialogues.jp: バカな……萌先輩が他人を叩くとは……。
dialogues.en: This can't be happening...... Moe-sempai smacked me......
dialogues.text: This can't be happening...... Moe-sempai smacked me......

dialogues.jp:
いや――それは叩くというよりも、むしろ……
かち割るといった類のものだった……。
dialogues.en: No -- it wasn't like smacking...... but smashing......
dialogues.text: No -- it wasn't like smacking...... but smashing......

dialogues.jp: ぐほっ――
dialogues.en: Arrgg-----
dialogues.text: Arrgg-----

dialogues.jp: なんだ〜〜ッ！？　今のは？
dialogues.en: What was that!? What was that?
dialogues.text: What was that!? What was that?

dialogues.jp:
頭が真っ二つになるような感覚と、｛ずがいこつ／頭蓋骨｝をや
すやすと貫くような衝撃――１００万の脳細胞
を瞬殺したような、そんな破壊力だった。
dialogues.en:
It felt like my head was cracked open -- it felt like it
killed a million brain cells.
dialogues.text:
It felt like my head was cracked open -- it felt like it
killed a million brain cells.

dialogues.jp:
萌先輩が、これほどの戦闘力を秘めていようと
は……。
dialogues.en: I didn't know Moe-sempai had this much strength......
dialogues.text: I didn't know Moe-sempai had this much strength......

dialogues.jp:
目を開けたはずなのに、景色が見えてこない。
ただ、白い世界が広がっているだけだ。
dialogues.en:
I couldn't see a thing when I opened my eyes. It was just
all white.
dialogues.text:
I couldn't see a thing when I opened my eyes. It was just
all white.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「やっと起きた」
dialogues.en: "Finally."
dialogues.text: "Finally."

dialogues.jp: なぜか、別人の声が聞こえる。
dialogues.en: I heard Mako's voice.
dialogues.text: I heard Mako's voice.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「兄さん、起きましたか？」
dialogues.en: "Niisan, are you awake?"
dialogues.text: "Niisan, are you awake?"

dialogues.jp: 眞子の隣には音夢が立っていた。
dialogues.en: Nemu was standing next to Mako.
dialogues.text: Nemu was standing next to Mako.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「もう、素直に起きなさいよね。あんまり、妹
　に苦労かけるんじゃないの」
dialogues.en:
"You should've woken up earlier. Don't give Nemu too much
hassle."
dialogues.text:
"You should've woken up earlier. Don't give Nemu too much
hassle."

dialogues.jp:
何かの雑誌を手に持ちながら、眞子が呆れた声
で言う。
dialogues.en: Mako was standing there with a magazine in her hand.
dialogues.text: Mako was standing there with a magazine in her hand.

dialogues.jp: 「……なに、ソレ」
dialogues.en: "......What's that?"
dialogues.text: "......What's that?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「対寝ボ助用最終兵器」
dialogues.en: "It's the final weapon against oversleeping."
dialogues.text: "It's the final weapon against oversleeping."

dialogues.en: ...What?
dialogues.text: ...What?

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「辞書なんかより、こういう薄い方が空気抵抗
　とかが少なくって、利くんだよね。ピンポイ
　ントだし」
dialogues.en:
"It works better than a thick dictionary as it doesn't have
much air resistance. It can also be targeted better too."
dialogues.text:
"It works better than a thick dictionary as it doesn't have
much air resistance. It can also be targeted better too."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「それに、大事なのは全体の強度じゃなくて、
　角の硬さだから」
dialogues.en:
"It's also important to have the hard corner instead of the
hard cover."
dialogues.text:
"It's also important to have the hard corner instead of the
hard cover."

dialogues.jp:
そう言って、手にしている雑誌をぐにゃぐにゃ
させる。
dialogues.en: She bent the magazine to prove her point.
dialogues.text: She bent the magazine to prove her point.

dialogues.jp: 俺を殺す気ですか？
dialogues.en: Is she going to kill me?
dialogues.text: Is she going to kill me?

dialogues.jp: 後頭部っすよ？　後・頭・部！
dialogues.en: It was on the back of my head! The back!
dialogues.text: It was on the back of my head! The back!

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「音夢の性格じゃ、こいつ起こすの大変だろう
　から、てこずってたらまた手伝ってあげるね」
dialogues.en:
"It must be a hassle for Nemu to wake him up, so I'll help
you if you have trouble again."
dialogues.text:
"It must be a hassle for Nemu to wake him up, so I'll help
you if you have trouble again."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「そうですね。そのときは、申し訳ありません
　が、宜しくお願いします」
dialogues.en: "Yes, please. I'd appreciate your help."
dialogues.text: "Yes, please. I'd appreciate your help."

dialogues.jp: 裏モードの音夢が、上品な笑みで答える。
dialogues.en: Nemu replied to Mako with a fake smile.
dialogues.text: Nemu replied to Mako with a fake smile.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「じゃあ、あたしお姉ちゃんの所に行くから」
dialogues.en: "I better get going to meet my sister."
dialogues.text: "I better get going to meet my sister."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「はい、どうもありがとうございました」
dialogues.en: "Yes, thank you again for you help."
dialogues.text: "Yes, thank you again for you help."

dialogues.jp: 眞子は音夢に軽く手を振って、廊下に出て行く。
dialogues.en: Mako waved at Nemu and left the room.
dialogues.text: Mako waved at Nemu and left the room.

dialogues.jp: 「なぜ、お前が起こさなかったんだ？」
dialogues.en: "Why didn't you wake me up?"
dialogues.text: "Why didn't you wake me up?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「起こしました。兄さんが起きて下さらなかっ
　ただけです」
dialogues.en: "I tried, but you didn't wake up."
dialogues.text: "I tried, but you didn't wake up."

dialogues.jp: ……裏モードのお前で、起きるわけないだろう！
dialogues.en:
...How am I going to wake up with her pretending to be such
a sweetie pie?
dialogues.text:
...How am I going to wake up with her pretending to be such
a sweetie pie?

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「これからはちゃんと起きて下さいね。私では、
　兄さんを起こすのは大変なんですから」
dialogues.en:
"Please wake up next time. It's such a hassle for me to wake
you up."
dialogues.text:
"Please wake up next time. It's such a hassle for me to wake
you up."

dialogues.jp:
万人を｛あざむ／欺｝く、妹の笑顔に、俺は口をつぐむしか
なかった……。
dialogues.en: I couldn't say anything at her fake smile.
dialogues.text: I couldn't say anything at her fake smile.

dialogues.jp:
とりあえず、飯を食いに行こう。せっかく、命
懸けの起床を果たしたのだ。無駄にはできん。
dialogues.en:
I better go eat now. I woke up with my life on the line. I
should not waste it.
dialogues.text:
I better go eat now. I woke up with my life on the line. I
should not waste it.

dialogues.jp:
俺は席を立つと、生き残った兵で、どこに行く
かを考える。
dialogues.en:
I stood up, and thought about where to go with the rest of
my brain cells.
dialogues.text:
I stood up, and thought about where to go with the rest of
my brain cells.

dialogues.jp: ◆萌先輩の夢◆
dialogues.en: ◆Dream about Moe-sempai◆
dialogues.text: ◆Dream about Moe-sempai◆

dialogues.jp: 萌先輩の夢を見た。
dialogues.en: I had a dream about Moe-sempai.
dialogues.text: I had a dream about Moe-sempai.

dialogues.jp: 先輩が、俺を優しく起こしてくれる夢だ……。
dialogues.en: It was a dream that she was waking me up nicely......
dialogues.text: It was a dream that she was waking me up nicely......
